integrity: Theorem has a complete mathematical proof using the known theta identity, an argument-principle divisor count, real convexity, and asymptotics. A finite numerical checker is corroboration, not an infinite proof. Mathematical originality remains subject to an independent historical review.
scientific_limitations: The statement concerns the weighted annular Szegő series, not arbitrary kernels. The fixed-basepoint physical count holds for sufficiently small Q; the critical-point orbit result is for all Q and t. It does not give a parameter-uniform small-nome threshold. The classical theta quotient is imported, not newly derived.
title: Two real critical-point orbits of weighted annular Szegő kernels and a disappearing-hole phase law
